item.title: The Line to be 'radically scaled back' after new review
item.description: Saudi Arabia is preparing to significantly scale back and redesign NEOM, the flagship development launched in 2017 under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, following years of delays and budget overruns. According to new reporting by The Financial Times, a year-long internal review nearing completion is expected to recommend a substantially smaller and more pragmatic version of the project. item.title: Trump moves to take over LA wildfire rebuilding with new executive order
item.description: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order intended to allow him to take over Los Angeles wildfire recovery efforts from local and state authorities. Over 16,000 structures were destroyed across the Pacific Palisades and Altadena in wildfires in early 2025. The order, titled ‘Addressing State and Local Failures to Rebuild Los Angeles After Wildfire Disasters,’ includes heavy criticisms of state and local authorities both before and after the fires. item.title: Pine Flat by Faulkner Architects
item.description: Remotely accessed via a winding former stagecoach road north-east of Healdsburg, California, the 2019 Kincade Fire destroyed the original off-grid house. The pioneering resourcefulness of the clients allowed them to embrace an alternative, landscape-driven lifestyle, that follows the spirit of the nearby original historic Pine Flat community – a boomtown that flourished in the Mayacamas Mountains during the quicksilver and mercury rush in the 1870s.
